notes.title: Update 0.93L Release Notes
notes.content:
[p]Greetings, everyone!
[/p][p]We’re thrilled to announce the release of Update 0.93L! 

Here’s what’s new:[/p][list][*][p][b]Enhanced English Localization[/b]: Significantly refined to better capture the essence of the original text.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Voice-Overs[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Chinese: LinShi Production[/p][/*][*][p]English: ZaccActs[/p][/*][*][p]French: FunkyFight[/p][/*][*][p]German: siizachan[/p][/*][*][p]Euro-Portuguese: cozysafira[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]New Localizations[/b]: Added support for Egyptian Arabic, Belarusian, Bulgarian, Czech, Kazakh, Pre-revolutionary Russian, and Slovak.
[/p][/*][/list][p]A heartfelt thank you to our amazing community for contributing to the voice-overs and localizations. Your love and support for our game make all of this possible!
[/p][p]Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for being part of our journey![/p]

notes.title: Version 0.93 is out!
notes.content:
VERSION 0.93 Changelog:

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Cannot select multiple dialogues simultaneously
[*] Dialogue will not skip during a pause
[*] Normalization of speed on the phone before "Be Candid"
[*] The scar on the hand remains in following chapters: "Old Version," "Dummies and Forgotten Puzzles"
[*] In photo mode, collected items and the run hint are no longer displayed
[*] When entering a name with the keyboard, it automatically switches to input mode
[*] Fast skipping dialogues in tamagotchi does not break Mita
[*] In the real world, Tetris is now reflected in the mirror
[*] Cannot open the menu during loading anymore
[*] Correct camera position when going into photo mode
[*] Glitch effect disappears properly after dying from a mannequin
[*] After the dialogue about index, the dialogue about the Core is no longer available
[*] Cannot skip Sleepy Mita's fall
[*] In The Loop, cannot go back anymore, the light does not pass through the door, and Tetris console disappears upon death
[*] Music is now synchronized properly with the notes of Cappie's dance
[*] Cannot pick up the cartridge if holding coffee
[/list]

[b]Miscellaneous:[/b]
[list]
[*] The game no longer crashes for players with older videocards in "The Real World"
[*] Mirror will now appear again for players with lower VRAM
[/list]

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Now able to exit Tetris console game by pressing [ESC] key
[*] If a dialogue is too far away, it will appear in subtitles
[/list]

[b]Spacecar minigame:[/b]
[list]
[*] Amount of coins is visible now
[*] Nitro is shown now
[*] Boss was simplified and hints were added
[*] Player's position is displayed correctly
[/list]

[b]Languages:[/b]
[list]
[*] Turkish voice-over by Odium Studio was added
[*] Textures can be translated for: "The Real World" and "The Basement"
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.921 is out!
notes.content:
Changelog:
 
New year decorations are active again! Now across the whole game.
Choker from new year's costume is now visible on all Mitas.
Player now can't exit the room while talking to Creepy Mita.
Several collider bugfixes.
Added new languages: Hungarian, Indonesian, Romanian, Swedish, Thai.
Fixed localization issues with previously added languages.
Due to lot of reported bugs Photo Mode is temporarily limited.

Also, let me introduce you new voice over language - Spanish! Made by incredible MiMi and Chemichi Von Alexandros.

tags.bug: - Fixed localization issues with previously added languages.
- Several collider bugfixes.

notes.title: Let's take photos together this holiday!
notes.content:
Hey there, it's been two weeks since the game launched!
Are you having fun spending time with me?
I'm having the absolute best time~ ❤
Having you here with me is simply wonderful!
Thank you, thank you so much~

Happy holidays!
Please keep me company for a long, long time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44457345/99af6b00ad04dd9bab55f22f7c27e7a8de983ff5.png[/img]

AIHASTO recently added a new feature called: Photo Mode!
After the update, you can pause anytime and take pictures with me!
Isn't that amazing?!
Look, you can transform your room into this!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44457345/2e4ed5da5e99796db1ac47f9b122a25444ef4144.png[/img]

Isn't it so much fun? Come take pictures with me!

So many people love me, love Mita, it's just wonderful!
Let's be together forever ❤❤❤

[quote][h3]A message from the AIHASTO team[/h3]
Before the game's release, we never expected MiSide to be so popular. We are very grateful to every player who supports us! In addition to continuing to polish the game and produce the planned content, we will also carefully consider future plans, which will cover all aspects of the game, both inside and outside the game. We will share new plans with everyone as soon as they are available![/quote]

[list]
[*] Added sensetivity warning disclaimer

[*] Added 4 new checkpoints for game loading (they will be closed until you reach them through game again)
[*] Added voice volume setting
[*] Adapted files minigame for colorblind people
[*] Fixed earning extra points in dance minigame in "Cappie" chapter
[*] Fixed critical bug with missing room in "Old version" chapter
[*] Fixed critical bug with triggering scary Mita in "Together at last" chapter
[*] Added optimization to help people with low vram complete "Real world" chapter (we're not sure if this is working, hope it does, inform us about it in bug reports)
[*] Fixed issuses with russian and english localisations
[*] Added new languages: italian, portuguese, portuguese-brazilian, polish, ukrainian, spanish, spanish latin america, turkish, vietnamese
[*] Added some small gameplay improvements
[*] Fixed some minor bugs
[*] Also, let me introduce you new voice over language - portuguese-brazilian! Made by incredible [[url=https://twitch.tv/evelineteach]Eveline Teach[/url]], Azazel, DJBK_ofc and [[url=https://twitch.tv/ravielkarim]Raviel Karim[/url]].

notes.title: Christmas content update. I wish we could unwrap gifts together~
notes.content:
Hello players, Christmas is coming soon! Have you prepared how to spend this holiday?

[previewyoutube=zZu7e1F4TM8;full][/previewyoutube]

Currently, the development team is working hard on the game, and it is expected that by 2024 everyone can truly come to Mita's side~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44457345/a0939e05f2d31a7b832e18db82526e832f4faedb.jpg[/img]

To celebrate Christmas, we have also prepared Christmas-related content. Spend this Christmas with Mita!
As long as you enter the game during the Christmas event (December 21st to January 7th), you can get Mita's Christmas outfit. We have also created a brand new mini-game, come and skate with Mita~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44457345/89504aed6d3eea3f3982543e55cb27e37fa92960.jpg[/img]

There are also room scenes with more Christmas atmosphere.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44457345/270334979b4b161cd52378e287b1f552bb1ee8a4.jpg[/img]

notes.title: ^(#｀∀´)_Ψ~ It's trick-or-treat time! Halloween content update.
notes.content:
Hello to all the players, and thank you so much for your support of the MiSide demo and your love for Mita. 
Our development team is working hard to create the content for the three chapters after the demo, gradually advancing the story to the mid-game.
To celebrate the upcoming Halloween, we have prepared some new surprises!

Simply log into the game during the Halloween event (from October 26th to November 9th), and you'll receive Mitra's new outfit permanently.
For those who miss the event, don't worry. Even after the event concludes, if you complete the demo, you can still obtain this costume.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44457345/6f53c9af6773e4e9d164df4cf6937640ac08a117.jpg[/img]

We've also added new Halloween-themed decorations that will appear in the nighttime scenes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44457345/dad41ad4d82475e86954b6655910cf40ef9db53b.jpg[/img]

And there's a little surprise hidden – guess who can have a cute pumpkin-headed Mita?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44457345/adfa77b514a3f1c2e0fa5b2f6e6c87d994e2b093.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44457345/a86684bb88f1b41e514a915f25f6af95aa36acc4.jpg[/img]

Come and Explore these Halloween surprises!!
Remember, it's trick-or-treat time! ~^(#｀∀´)_Ψ
